eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: RhythmNatorEngine
eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Play and manage rhythm game beatmap exported from RhythmNator Editor.
description: This extension allows you to easily integrate a JSON beatmap-based music synchronization system into your GDevelop projects. It provides all the necessary tools to load music, control its playback, and trigger precise events based on beats and notes.
Designed for rhythm games, music-synchronized effects, or any system that relies on precise audio timing, it ensures consistency between audio playback and gameplay logic.
Load a beatmap and control playback without directly manipulating the audio channel, thus avoiding any synchronization issues.
- LoadBeatMap — Loads the beatmap and prepares the rhythmic data
- LoadJSONToScene — Initializes the data in the scene
- SetOffset — Sets a global offset to anticipate events
- Access global rhythmic information for the music and trigger actions on each beat.
- BeatProgress — Progression of the current beat (0 → 1)
- CurrentBeatIndex — Index of the current beat
Manipulate events defined in the beatmap with high timing precision.
- CurrentNoteIndex — Index of the current note
- OnNote — Trigger at the exact moment of a note
- OnNoteWithOffset — Predicted trigger based on the offset
- NoteProgressBetween — Progression between the current note and the next (0 → 1)
- NoteStringValue — Retrieves a text value (name, action, etc.)
- NoteNumberValue — Retrieves a numeric value (time, duration, etc.)
Rhythm games (like Guitar Hero, osu!, etc.)
Animations and effects Visuals on the beats

eventsFunctions.description:
Executes actions repeatedly while synchronizing with the beats of the music.
If the offset is less than 0, the action triggers before the beat.
If it is greater than 0, it triggers after the beat.
If the offset is 0, it triggers exactly on the beat.
eventsFunctions.name: RepeatOnBeat

eventsFunctions.description:
Returns the index of the beat currently processed by a RepeatOnBeat condition.
This value can be used to identify which beat is currently triggered during the repetition.

eventsFunctions.description:
Returns the progress of the current beat inside the Repeat On Beat condition.
The value is normalized between 0 and 1.

eventsFunctions.description:
The offset used in the RepeatOnBeat condition.
This value represents the time shift applied to the action trigger relative to the beat.
eventsFunctions.name: RepeatBeatOffset

eventsFunctions.description:
Executes actions for each note belonging to the specified group.
This condition works similarly to RepeatOnBeat, but it is based on the notes contained in a beatmap group.

the offset used in the RepeatOnNoteGroup condition.

eventsBasedObjects.description:
Object representing a note generated by the Rhythmnator system.
The note is spawned on a lane associated with a beatmap track and moves at a constant speed toward a Target object. When the note reaches the Target, the player must interact at the correct timing.

This object can also include a tail to represent long notes (hold notes).
